mechanism: Moxifloxacin may inhibit atazanavir absorption due to altered gastric pH and potential chelation, while atazanavir may increase moxifloxacin levels via CYP3A4 inhibition, increasing QT prolongation risk.
action: Monitor QTc interval; consider alternative fluoroquinolone or separate dosing by 2+ hours; baseline and follow-up ECG recommended.
